INSERT INTO risk_score (underpass_id, risk_score, rainfall_mm, rainfall_1h_mm, rainfall_3h_mm, rainfall_6h_mm, rainfall_12h_mm, rainfall_24h_mm, predicted_at) SELECT u.id, LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, wh.rainfall_mm * 3))::numeric(5,2), wh.rainfall_mm, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.rainfall_mm), 0) FROM weather_hourly w WHERE w.area_id = wh.area_id AND w.target_at > wh.target_at - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND w.target_at <= wh.target_at), (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.rainfall_mm), 0) FROM weather_hourly w WHERE w.area_id = wh.area_id AND w.target_at > wh.target_at - INTERVAL '3 hour' AND w.target_at <= wh.target_at), (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.rainfall_mm), 0) FROM weather_hourly w WHERE w.area_id = wh.area_id AND w.target_at > wh.target_at - INTERVAL '6 hour' AND w.target_at <= wh.target_at), (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.rainfall_mm), 0) FROM weather_hourly w WHERE w.area_id = wh.area_id AND w.target_at > wh.target_at - INTERVAL '12 hour' AND w.target_at <= wh.target_at), (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(w.rainfall_mm), 0) FROM weather_hourly w WHERE w.area_id = wh.area_id AND w.target_at > wh.target_at - INTERVAL '24 hour' AND w.target_at <= wh.target_at), NOW() FROM underpass u
CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT wa.id AS area_id FROM weather_area wa ORDER BY (wa.latitude - u.latitude) ^ 2 + (wa.longitude - u.longitude) ^ 2 LIMIT 1 ) nearest
CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT w.area_id, w.target_at, w.rainfall_mm FROM weather_hourly w WHERE w.area_id = nearest.area_id ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (w.target_at - NOW()))) LIMIT 1 ) wh WHERE u.is_deleted = FALSE
